record.body:
## Rationale

Requirement ids are unique only within a phase, so the phase is the natural home. It adds no key or tab, keeps the main pane about what is happening now, and fits 60 columns.

## Counter-argument

A separate screen shows unverified requirements across every phase at once, which matters once several structured phases are open together.

payload.alternatives: A separate Requirements screen on its own key; a requirements mode for the main task table
payload.choice: Requirements live under their phase: a tally on the phase header, a list in phase detail, and a requirement detail screen

record.subject: evidence-under-phase
